title: Event
description: One row of a store's append-only events table, as the bridge streams it to clients (design A.11). Each store (the workspace store and each Coworld store) has its own seq; a client keeps one cursor per store and ignores kinds it does not know.

store.description: workspace, or the Coworld id of a Coworld store.

kind.description: Dotted event kind, such as task.completed, notice or ui.patch.

subject.description: The record the event is about, in display form (T-42), or a name.

payload.description: Kind-specific data. A notice carries text, refs and urgency. A ui.patch carries ops (RFC 6902) and the conversation.
